summary: Muted rules reset after metrics compaction leading to unexpected notifications
description:
Issue summary: Multiple dashboard alert rules that were muted via the Console UI reverted to unmuted state after an hourly metrics compaction/retention job. Impact: AcmeRetail teams received repeated low-severity alert notifications and PagerDuty escalations during a time window when they expected silence. Scope: Observed for two dashboards and one inherited monitor across two application teams.

Observed behavior: Console shows 'Muted until <timestamp>' immediately after the admin action. The Alerts API and internal alert-evaluation service returned mute=false after the compaction job completed and evaluated the rule, causing notifications to be dispatched. The event is intermittent and reproducible when a compaction/rollup job runs shortly after the mute operation.

Expected behavior: Mute state set from Console or API should be durable across background retention/compaction operations and honored by the alert evaluation pipeline. No notifications should be fired for muted rules until the expiry time or user unmute action.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Login to Console as org-admin for the customer org.
2) Select an alert rule and choose 'Mute' for 1 hour.
3) Verify Console UI shows the mute TTL.
4) Call the Alerts API: GET /v1/alerts/{alert-id} and confirm mute=true.
5) Trigger or wait for the next metrics compaction/retention job.
6) After compaction, call GET /v1/alerts/{alert-id} and inspect alert-engine evaluation logs; observe mute=false and notification dispatch.

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: Console UI didn't persist mute flag to the metadata-store. UI logs showed write success so issue looked upstream.
Reproduced in staging by running a compaction on a snapshot of the customer org. Observed compaction write replacing a shard blob that did not include ephemeral mute metadata.

Root cause: the retention/compaction job reconstructs a compacted alert_rules blob but did not merge ephemeral per-rule metadata (mute flags live in an ephemeral map). Write-back overwrote the ephemeral map with an older snapshot missing mute entries.
Timeline: 14:02 mute set -> 14:59 compaction reads older snapshot -> 15:00 compaction writes blob without ephemeral_meta -> 15:00 alert evaluation reads mute=false -> notifications sent.
comments: 2026-03-10 14:25 - Sofia Patel (Support): Customer reports alerts firing despite mute. Confirmed console shows mute success. Escalated to SRE.
2026-03-10 16:10 - Ethan Ramirez (SRE): Reproduced in staging with compaction. Creating INT-4419 to track infra fix and prepare patch. Attached reproduction steps and logs.
2026-03-11 09:20 - Priya Nair (Engineer - alerting): Confirmed compaction write path omitted ephemeral_meta. Working on patch to merge ephemeral_meta on compaction writes. Adding integration tests.
2026-03-12 02:45 - DevOps: Patch deployed to canary in us-east; canary observed through two compaction windows with no regressions for test orgs.
2026-03-12 05:10 - Ethan Ramirez (SRE): Prod rollout completed. Verified for AcmeRetail: GET /v1/alerts/{id} returns mute=true after compaction; no notifications for muted rules in monitored samples.
2026-03-12 12:00 - Sofia Patel (Support): Customer acknowledgement received; they confirm unwanted notifications stopped. Preparing postmortem.
resolution: Workaround: Avoid triggering compaction within minutes of applying a mute; if compaction is imminent, re-apply mute via API after compaction. Permanent fix: merged change to compaction write path to merge ephemeral per-rule metadata (mute flags) instead of overwriting. Deployed to canary then prod on 2026-03-12. Added a post-compaction validation job that samples muted rules and asserts mute=true; created migration script 'reconcile-mute-flags-2026-03-12' to repair any orgs that lost mute entries during the incident. Follow-ups: add unit/integration tests, update compaction runbook, and publish postmortem.
